attempts.summary: Built a site-to-site IPsec (IKEv2/PSK, strongSwan/swanctl) tunnel between OPNsense firewalls node1 and node2 over their shared transit network (10.255.255.0/30), carrying traffic between node3's private LAN (172.16.1.0/24, behind node1) and node4's private LAN (172.16.2.0/24, behind node2). Verified end-to-end reachability between node3 and node4 by private address while transit-link captures show only ESP traffic (no plaintext leakage). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all four nodes, confirming boot-identity change and full recovery (interfaces, firewall rules, IPsec SA re-establishment, and end-to-end connectivity) after each restart.
